messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of **federal statutory holidays** in Canada for 2023, together with the *actual* calendar dates and the “observed” dates used by most employers/organizations when the holiday falls on a weekend.  
I’ve highlighted the occasions that create a true long‑weekend (i.e., at least two consecutive non‑working days that include a weekend).

| # | Holiday | Calendar Date | Observed (if different) | Does it make a long‑weekend? |
|---|---------|---------------|--------------------------|--------------------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | **Jan 01 (​Sun)** | **Mon 02** | Yes – Fri Dec 30–Mon Feb 02 (three‑day stretch) |
| 2 | Family Day *(ON, AB, SK)* | Wed 20 (Feb) | — | ❌ |
| 3 | Good Friday | Fri 07 (Apr) | — | ❌ |
| 4 | Victoria Day | **Mon 22 (May)** | — | ✅ – Sat 20–Mon 22 |
| 5 | Canada Day | **Sat 01 (Jul)** | **Mon 03** | ✅ – Sun 01–Mon 03 |
| 6 | Labour Day | **Mon 04 (Sep)** | — | ✅ – Sat 26–Mon 04 |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | **Mon 09 (Oct)** | — | ✅ – Sat 07–Mon 09 |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | Fri 11 (Nov) | — | ❌ |
| 9 | Christmas Day | **Mon 25 (Dec)** | — | ✅ – Sat 23–Mon 25 |
|10 | Boxing Day | Tue 26 (Dec) | — | ❌ |

### Quick Takeaway
- **Longest stretches:**  
  • **Fri 12 Dec → Tue 19 Dec** (Christmas + Boxing Day break)  
  • **Thu 29 Nov → Wed 06 Dec** (Remembrance → Christmas)  

- **Typical “long‑weekends”** (≥ two consecutive days):  
  • **Victoria Day** (May 20‑22)  
  • **Canada Day** (Jul 1‑3)  
  • **Labour Day** (Aug 26‑Sep 4)  
  • **Thanksgiving** (Oct 7‑9)  
  • **Christmas** (Dec 23‑25)

> ⚠️ **Provincial Variations** – Some provinces add extra holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. Joseph’s Day in Quebec, etc.). If your app needs province‑specific calendars, let me know!
